extraction.notes: Reconciliation from 'Net income available for MAA common shareholders' on page 9. Current-quarter (three months ended March 31, 2025) column only. AFFO starts from Core FFO and deducts recurring capital expenditures; other capex lines (redevelopment, revenue enhancing, commercial, other) appear after Core AFFO in the FAD section and are excluded from AFFO. Diluted share count 119,975 thousand is the 'Weighted average common shares and units - diluted' under Funds From Operations Shares And Units on page 7 (the FFO share count printed on page 9 is the same figure). Recomputed per-share: FFO 264,728/119,975 = 2.21; Core FFO 264,262/119,975 = 2.20; Core AFFO 244,156/119,975 = 2.04, all matching reported. Labels retain footnote markers as printed.
